_comment: Per-monster drop tables. Key = MonID (string). Value = list of {item_id, rate, quantity}, where rate is the item's INDEPENDENT 0..1 chance to drop on a kill (each entry rolls on its own, so a kill can yield several items or none). Monsters NOT listed here fall back to loot.py's shared global pool. Example: "1": [{"item_id": 4770, "rate": 0.10, "quantity": 1}, {"item_id": 5357, "rate": 0.02, "quantity": 1}]
